subject: Extended access request for expired trial (APEX-POC)
messages:
From: Natalie Gomez <natalie@apexanalytics.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Trial environment access expired during benchmark run

Hi Rohan,

We kicked off the Redwood POC two weeks ago and had been running batch evaluations against the 13B model. Midway through a long benchmarking job yesterday our trial credits hit zero and the environment was locked. This interrupted benchmarking and now our procurement window is closing next week.

Can Redwood make a one-time safety-net extension so we can finish final comparisons and produce the evaluation report for our engineering and procurement teams? Ideally we need ~200k tokens or 14 days of extended sandbox access. We used account ID APEX-78023 and I attached the evaluation excerpt showing where the job failed.

We'd prefer not to restart a new trial — that would mean re-onboarding and more delays. Happy to sign a short mutual action plan or acceptance form if that helps.

Thanks,
Natalie Gomez
Director of ML
Apex Analytics
Attachment: evaluation-report.pdf (excerpt)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie@apexanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial environment access expired during benchmark run

Natalie — thanks for the note and the excerpt. Sorry this interrupted your run — that’s frustrating when you’re deep in a benchmark.

I can escalate a one-time extension to Billing and Sales Ops. Can you confirm the following so I can include exact ask in the approval:
- Confirm account ID (APEX-78023) and primary contact for the MAP
- Exact token/top-up amount you want (you mentioned ~200k tokens; confirm if we should budget 200k or 250k)
- Any security/compliance constraints (e.g., do you require that the test data be deleted after the window)

If you’re flexible I’ll propose a 14-day safety-net top-up for the POC while we finalize procurement. I’ve looped in Monica (billing) and Ben (sales manager) to expedite authorization.

Next step: if you can confirm the token amount and sign a simple MAP, I’ll push for same-week approval.

—Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Trial environment access expired during benchmark run

Rohan — thanks for the context. Billing Ops can issue a one-time promotional credit but we need manager approval and a completed authorization template.

Proposed guardrails:
- One-time promo token allocation, up to 150k tokens (equivalent to ~$3,500)
- 14-day expiration from issuance
- Billing hold until we receive a signed MAP or PO from the prospect (no automatic conversion to chargeable usage)

Please attach the MAP doc and confirm the exact token amount request. I attached the promo_authorization_template.docx I’ll need filled out for audit.

If the customer needs >150k tokens we can escalate to Ben for discretionary approval.

Monica Patel
Billing & Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachment: promo_authorization_template.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T14:15:00-08:00
Subject: Approval: APEX POC temporary credit (conditional)

Approving on a conditional basis.

Authorization: one-time 150,000 token credit under promo token APEX-EXT-1126. Conditions:
1) Customer signs the attached MAP (I reviewed Rohan’s draft).
2) Access window is 14 days from issuance; credits expire and will not roll forward.
3) Procurement must confirm acceptance by 2026-12-05; otherwise we revoke the hold and the account returns to standard limits.

Rohan, please instruct Ops to provision the promo token and set a billing hold for account APEX-78023. Finance will not bill while the MAP is in flight.

Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie@apexanalytics.com>, procurement@apexanalytics.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Approved: temporary extension for APEX POC (APEX-EXT-1126)

Hi Natalie / Procurement team — good news. Ben and Monica approved a one-time extension to get you over the finish line. Details below: 

What we’re granting:
- Promo token: APEX-EXT-1126
- Amount: 150,000 tokens (one-time)
- Window: 14 days from issuance; expires 2026-12-11 23:59 UTC
- Conditions: customer signs the attached MAP (map_apex_draft.docx) or returns a PO confirming acceptance by 2026-12-05. Finance will hold billing until MAP/PO is received.

Next steps for you:
1) Sign the MAP I attached (or send a short PO) — I can accept a scanned signature if needed.
2) Confirm whether you want us to apply the promo now (we can turn it on immediately) or hold until you confirm.
3) If you need a slightly larger uplift after we start the run, notify me ASAP and I’ll request discretionary escalation (may take 24–48h).

I’ve attached the MAP draft and forwarded the authorization template Monica requested. Let me know if you want a quick 15-minute call to align on acceptance language.

Thanks — happy to get you unstuck.
—Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: map_apex_draft.docx, promo_authorization_template.docx
